question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: **

The monk carried a carved **crosier **into the sanctuary.

options.text: The florist added white crosiers to the bouquet.
The bishop's crosier gleamed under the candlelight.
The museum displayed a gilded 14th-century crosier.
The abbot's ceremonial crosier was stolen.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"crosier"** refers to a ceremonial staff carried by high-ranking members of the clergy, such as bishops or abbots. (धार्मिक छड़ी)

 
 
• **Example:** The bishop's crosier was adorned with intricate designs and gold embellishments.
 
 
 
• The word **"crosier"** in Option 1 is used as a homonym and refers to a type of fern plant with curled fronds that resemble a shepherd’s crook. (फर्न पौधे की मुड़ी हुई पत्तियां)
 
 
• **Example:** The florist added white crosiers to the bouquet to enhance its beauty.
 
 
 
• Hence, Option 1 contains the homonym of the highlighted word.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Refers to the ceremonial staff carried by the bishop. (धार्मिक छड़ी)

 
 
• **Example:** The bishop’s crosier gleamed under the candlelight during the service.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Refers to a historical or decorative ceremonial staff displayed in a museum. (धार्मिक छड़ी)
 
 
• **Example:** The museum displayed a gilded 14th-century crosier as part of its religious artifacts collection.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Refers to the ceremonial staff used by an abbot. (धार्मिक छड़ी)
 
 
• **Example:** The abbot’s ceremonial crosier was stolen from the monastery.
 
 

41:Tcd2,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
